input: The full 12,956-rune LP2-00–55 stream as one 29-rune frequency vector. Six key-value distributions are inherited exactly from source Stage U.
model: c=pi2(s*pi1(p)+t*pi3(k)+a) on GP29. Alphabet choices are identity and each named keyword's keyed permutation and inverse, deduplicated to 68. Source evaluates all 68^3 triples for each of six key-value distributions, maximizing unigram LLR over its three sign modes and 29 offsets.
controls: Before LP2, 50 same-member synthetic controls per family must avoid the <=-10 exclusion cutoff or the run is void. For each family, a model triple is powered when it scores <=-10 on at least 18 of 20 flat-key synthetic controls.
decision: Source labels a member raw-excluded if its best unigram LLR <=-10, a lead if >=+10, and reports the G2 power mask separately. Liberpedia calls a row a powered exclusion only when both source tests hold. A testable non-exclusion has LLR>-10 and passes G2. Every other row is untestable under this control rule.
limitations: This is one finite named-alphabet and iid-key distribution screen on unigram counts, not a sequence-level decryption. Most keyword triples share choices and must not be counted as independent solving ideas. Other keywords, alphabets, key order, page boundaries and layered ciphers remain outside scope.
